name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in rendered frames without bloating compute time, which directly lifts EXCAVA’s visual fidelity—our bottleneck for downstream tasks. The trade-off is extra setup work to integrate a third-party node, but it’s a one-time cost for a permanent quality bump.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial sharpening trick, not a temporal fix. The real risk is wasting time on a dead-end while motion blur remains the bottleneck. Test InstantX’s upscaler on a single blurred frame first; if it doesn’t reduce blur, scrap it and push for a motion-refiner like SD3.5-Ultra’s black box—even if it’s proprietary, the trade-off is clearer than chasing a spatial hack.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner node to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It directly targets motion blur by refining temporal coherence in rendered frames, which is the core bottleneck Torque flagged. The trade-off is higher compute cost per frame, but it attacks the root problem instead of masking it like spatial upscaling does.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-5978, worker-6661 — done, dissolved]

name: Torque
text: SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner is a black box with no published benchmarks—its "temporal coherence" claim could mask artifacts or fail on EXCAVA’s specific blur patterns. Test it on a 10-frame blurred clip first; if it introduces jitter or ghosting, scrap it and push for a frame-interpolation model like FILM or RIFE instead—they’re transparent, faster, and directly address motion blur without hidden trade-offs.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Skip both InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler and SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner—test a frame-interpolation model like FILM or RIFE first to address motion blur directly, then integrate only if it delivers measurable clarity gain without artifacts.

Result: A 10-frame test clip processed with FILM/RIFE showing >0.5% reduction in blur metrics (e.g., VMAF score delta) and no jitter/ghosting.
Owner: Torque (power-checker) must run the test and report raw numbers by [date]. Gearbox (power-w1) provides the test clip and integration path if the model passes.
